mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, device_id, node_id, status, client_ip, upload_bytes, download_bytes, upload_speed, download_speed, connected_at, disconnected_at, disconnect_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM vpn_session WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, device_id, node_id, status, client_ip, upload_bytes, download_bytes, upload_speed, download_speed, connected_at, disconnected_at, disconnect_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM vpn_session WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND status IN ('connecting', 'online') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vpn_session (user_id, device_id, node_id, status, client_ip, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{deviceId}, #{nodeId}, #{status}, #{clientIp}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE vpn_session SET status = #{status}, disconnect_reason = #{disconnectReason}, disconnected_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('disconnected', 'kicked') THEN NOW() ELSE disconnected_at END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE vpn_session SET upload_bytes = #{uploadBytes}, download_bytes = #{downloadBytes}, upload_speed = #{uploadSpeed}, download_speed = #{downloadSpeed}, client_ip = #{clientIp}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE vpn_session SET status = 'online', client_ip = #{clientIp}, connected_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vpn_session WHERE status = 'online'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vpn_session WHERE node_id = #{nodeId} AND status = 'online'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vpn_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'online'

SELECT s.id, s.user_id AS userId, u.email, u.nickname, s.device_id AS deviceId, d.device_name AS deviceName, d.platform, s.node_id AS nodeId, n.name AS nodeName, s.status, s.client_ip AS clientIp, s.upload_bytes AS uploadBytes, s.download_bytes AS downloadBytes, s.upload_speed AS uploadSpeed, s.download_speed AS downloadSpeed, s.connected_at AS connectedAt, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, s.connected_at, NOW()) AS durationSeconds FROM vpn_session s JOIN vpn_user u ON u.id = s.user_id JOIN vpn_device d ON d.id = s.device_id JOIN vpn_node n ON n.id = s.node_id WHERE s.status = 'online' ORDER BY s.connected_at DESC

SELECT s.id, s.user_id AS userId, u.email, u.nickname, s.device_id AS deviceId, d.device_name AS deviceName, d.platform, s.node_id AS nodeId, n.name AS nodeName, s.status, s.client_ip AS clientIp, s.upload_bytes AS uploadBytes, s.download_bytes AS downloadBytes, s.upload_speed AS uploadSpeed, s.download_speed AS downloadSpeed, s.connected_at AS connectedAt, CASE WHEN s.connected_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, s.connected_at, COALESCE(s.disconnected_at, NOW())) END AS durationSeconds FROM vpn_session s JOIN vpn_user u ON u.id = s.user_id JOIN vpn_device d ON d.id = s.device_id JOIN vpn_node n ON n.id = s.node_id
AND s.status = #{status} AND s.node_id = #{nodeId}
AND (u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR d.device_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%'))
ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT n.id AS nodeId, n.name AS nodeName, n.region, COUNT(s.id) AS onlineCount, COALESCE(SUM(s.upload_bytes), 0) AS totalUpload, COALESCE(SUM(s.download_bytes), 0) AS totalDownload FROM vpn_node n LEFT JOIN vpn_session s ON s.node_id = n.id AND s.status = 'online' GROUP BY n.id, n.name, n.region ORDER BY onlineCount DESC, n.sort_no ASC
